question: What out-of-plane compressive strain was imposed on the V2O5, what in-plane tensile strain does the Poisson estimate give for it and with what coefficient, and what is the ratio of the two?
expect: 0.5% out of plane, 1.6% in plane with v = 0.3 (p3.L24-28): ratio 3.2
rendered:
According to the text, the out-of-plane compressive strain imposed on the V2O5 is less than 1% (as shown in Figure 2b). 

Using the Poisson ratio (v = 0.3), the in-plane tensile strain is estimated to be 1.6% (as shown in Figure 2c).

The ratio of the in-plane tensile strain to the out-of-plane compressive strain is 1.6% / 0.5% = 3.2.
